title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Jelly Beans Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Jelly Beans combines the bright, fruity sweetness of Strawberry with the playful flavour of classic red confectionery. The Strawberry takes centre stage with a bold, jammy note, softened by sugary undertones that mimic the flavour of jelly sweets. Crafted with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers fast-acting satisfaction with a smoother throat hit, perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG formula ensures balanced vapour production and consistent flavour delivery. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
